title: Jude and the Border
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Blackwood, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
